# Marilla Cuthbert & Martin

- [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — Commands — [Martin](../character/martin.md) — hired hand driving her into town · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P28](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0028)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies from the shock of reading about the Abbey Bank failure. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) grieve together and carry out Matthew's funeral with the support of neighbors. Afterwards, life slowly resumes at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to visit an eye specialist while chatting with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about past memories.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death
